summary: Steven Bartlett is a 33-year-old British entrepreneur and media mogul who dropped out of formal education to build Steven.com, a creator economy company. He is the host of the high-profile podcast 'The Diary of a CEO' and an investor in over 100 companies, including a co-founding role in web3 platform thirdweb. His public persona blends high-level business strategy with accessible self-improvement content, leveraging a massive Instagram following to drive engagement for his media IP and social initiatives like his partnership with Prince William on homelessness.
